name: Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem
description:
A premium long-reach stem for modern track positions

The Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem is a high-performance track stem developed for riders building around modern long-reach cockpit setups.

Machined from hard-anodised aerospace-grade 7075-T651 aluminium and finished with titanium screws, this is a stem built around stiffness, front-end precision and confidence under load. Long stems only work when they feel absolutely secure. Anything less defeats the point.

The Elite Track Stem has been designed for riders who want a stronger, cleaner and more premium solution for aggressive track cockpit setups, with a minimalist form that delivers both a refined aero profile and a serious visual presence on the bike.

Why choose the Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem?

Built for modern track geometry

Modern track setups often demand more stem length than many riders expect, particularly when working towards a longer, more forward cockpit position within UCI regulations. This stem is designed specifically for that reality.

Premium 7075-T651 construction

Manufactured from hard-anodised aerospace-grade 7075-T651 aluminium, a premium heat-treated and stress-relieved alloy specification chosen for high-strength precision-machined components.

Fully CNC machined

Precision CNC machining delivers a cleaner finish, tighter consistency and the kind of detail expected from a serious high-end track component.

Low-profile steerer clamp

A low-profile steerer tube clamp improves integration with framesets and contributes to a cleaner, more purposeful front-end silhouette.

Minimalist aero-led design

A stripped-back, purposeful form designed for a cleaner aero profile and a more refined appearance on modern track bikes.

Built for stiffness and front-end confidence

Long stems place greater demands on the front end of the bike. The Elite Track Stem is built to deliver the stable, secure and confidence-inspiring feel that serious track riders expect.

Technical specification

Material: Hard-anodised aerospace-grade 7075-T651 aluminium

Hardware: Titanium screws

Designed for serious track riders

The Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem is intended for riders who want more than just a longer road stem adapted to track use. It is for riders who need real front-end confidence when building around modern track geometry.

That includes:

Sprinters pushing further into aggressive race positions

Bunch Race Riders looking for a cleaner and more stable cockpit solution

Stem calculator

Not sure which size is right for your setup?

We have created a dedicated
Track Cycling Cockpit Calculator
to help riders work towards a modern forward track position and identify the most suitable stem option from our range.

Try our Calculator here

Track bikes are not road bikes, and modern track setups are often built around a much longer and more forward cockpit than many riders first expect. That means a long stem is often not unusual at all. In many cases, it is simply the correct solution. The issue is not long stems themselves. The issue is whether the stem is stiff enough, precise enough and well designed enough to justify that position. That is exactly why we created the Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem.

Velodrome.Shop Elite Track Stem - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is this a track-specific stem?

Yes. The Elite Track Stem has been developed specifically for track cycling and the positional demands of modern track bike setup.

Why are long stems normal on track bikes?

Because modern track positions often use a longer and more forward cockpit than a road setup. Depending on your frame and bar choice, a long stem can be completely normal.

What is 7075-T651 aluminium?

7075-T651 is a premium heat-treated and stress-relieved aluminium specification used for high-strength precision-machined components. It reflects a more tightly controlled material condition than generic aluminium descriptions and is well suited to a serious high-performance stem.

Is this suitable for sprint riders?

Yes. This stem has been developed with the stiffness, front-end control and positional demands of serious track riding in mind.

Is this suitable for bunch races as well?

Yes. Any rider building around a modern long-reach cockpit setup can benefit from a stem designed specifically for this purpose.

Why buy from Velodrome.Shop?

Velodrome.Shop is built around track cycling. We understand the equipment, the setups and the detail that matters. Velodrome.Shop supplies high-performance track cycling equipment to riders, teams and federations around the world. When you buy from Velodrome.Shop, you are buying from people who understand modern track positions, cockpit setup and performance equipment.
